rule_name: Undercut the Achievement in the Same Breath
quote: Chloe does four in the first fifteen minutes
why: the whole Thursday-program sequence gives Chloe's speed full scene-time without ever pairing it, in the same breath, with a ranking or comparison the way the rule requires
suggestion: Chloe does four in the first fifteen minutes, though Dev, who took ninety seconds on the knights-and-knaves one, would probably do it in ten

rule_name: The Said-Bookism Overcorrection, Vary Attribution in Long Exchanges
quote: You want me to be like this, you want me to stay exactly like this
why: opens an eight-line exchange running through line 125 with no dialogue tags or action beats at all beyond the single word 'Chloe.', stripping tone and physicality from the chapter's most charged scene
suggestion: add a beat mid-run, e.g. before the denial: "Her mom's hand goes flat on the counter. 'That's not true,' she says, 'and you know perfectly well it isn't true.'"
